observations.why: Imperative command directed at an audience enacts authority-ranking: the speaker issues a directive to alter the listener's knowledge state.
Second imperative command reinforces authority-ranking: speaker directs the audience to excise specific information, enacting hierarchical control over what is known.

Declarative assertion of institutional fact enacts authority-ranking: the speaker unilaterally establishes what the observatory's record is, exercising epistemic authority over the institution's history.

mints.name: DirectiveMemoryOverride
mints.title: Forget… Remove all knowledge… The observatory never calibrated it.
mints.frame: Is the speaker exercising authority by commanding what the audience must treat as unknown or nonexistent?
